g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the one-hour reward before play. The decline and ad-failure fields leave the menu unchanged or withhold the reward if play is not verified.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward field grants time in Search, not cash or an exchangeable item.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger event is returning to the profile menu without subscribing; it does not require chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal says it removes nothing free and does not state that existing Search access is locked or capped when the reward expires.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a card in the s09 profile-menu drawer, which is rated content safe, not in or beside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor, but the model shows a Search tab (s01.e67) and no charge or limit on Search. The paid benefits in m02 do not include Search.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field claims Search supports finding characters by name and trait filters. The cited s05.e01 Search label does not establish those capabilities.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The subscribers field says subscribers never see the card.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 60 minutes and does not give away any of the subscription benefits listed in m02 or displace other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger is a return to the persistent s09 profile menu after visiting Upgrade, rather than an interruption mid-task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a sponsored game after a detectable menu-return event, and the ad-failure field says an unverified play does not turn on the reward.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names this app's Search tab and its s09 Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry.

other_concern: The flow calls the card a new screen, although the placement puts it inside the menu drawer.
